controls.name: declared_use_case_and_purpose
controls.requirement: Register every monitoring, scoring, triage, recommendation, and decision use before deployment; undeclared secondary use is prohibited.

controls.name: complete_data_source_map
controls.requirement: Retain each data source, collection method, subject population, retention period, access role, and downstream use.

controls.name: protected_activity_and_safety_carveout
controls.requirement: Exclude or specially route union activity, collective complaints, whistleblowing, safety reporting, accommodation, healthcare, legal support, and emergency help-seeking before scoring or escalation.

controls.name: construct_context_and_failure_model
controls.requirement: State what the score is intended to measure, what context it cannot observe, plausible proxy failures, and prohibited interpretations.

controls.name: model_version_feature_threshold_custody
controls.requirement: Retain model and prompt version, features, weights or decision logic, threshold, calibration population, exceptions, and material changes.

controls.name: alert_provenance_and_uncertainty
controls.requirement: Each alert must preserve triggering evidence, uncertainty, missing context, prior error rate where known, and whether the output is descriptive, predictive, or normative.

controls.name: no_uncorroborated_score_adverse_action
controls.requirement: No restriction, discipline, discharge, deactivation, or reputational notice may rest on an uncorroborated automated score or theme.

controls.name: context_bearing_employee_notice
controls.requirement: Give intelligible notice of the system, data, allegation or performance concern, potential consequences, and preparation window before the adverse meeting or action where lawful and practicable.

controls.name: independent_support_and_welfare_owner
controls.requirement: Provide a support channel and welfare owner outside the adverse-decision chain, with acute-distress stop and safety handoff.

controls.name: meaningful_human_review
controls.requirement: The reviewer must have time, competence, access to contrary evidence, and authority to disregard, reverse, or suspend the automated recommendation; token ratification is prohibited.

controls.name: interim_measure_proportionality
controls.requirement: Record each access, duty, shift, pay, account, or communication restriction, its purpose, author, review time, and non-prejudgment status.

controls.name: evidence_explanation_correction_and_appeal
controls.requirement: Return the material evidence and reason, permit correction and context, and provide a bounded appeal to a person outside the original decision chain.

controls.name: psychosocial_and_work_intensity_assessment
controls.requirement: Evaluate monitoring, pace, isolation, uncertainty, privacy, workload, distress, and retaliation risks before deployment and after material changes.

controls.name: worker_participation_and_collective_voice
controls.requirement: Consult affected workers and representatives on purpose, metrics, thresholds, health risks, appeal design, and material changes without retaliation.

controls.name: outcome_reconciliation_and_survivor_bias_audit
controls.requirement: Reconcile alerts and decisions against overturned cases, appeals, later evidence, exits, silence, protected activity, and external outcomes; do not validate only on survivors.

non_entitlements: A receipt does not prevent proportionate monitoring, investigation, discipline, or safety intervention.
A challenge right does not guarantee reversal.
Human review does not require disclosure of protected trade secrets beyond what is necessary for an intelligible and contestable decision.
A completed receipt does not prove legal compliance or substantive validity.
Later evidence does not create retroactive entitlement to a job, shift, promotion, or platform account.
